result.instructions: Tools for Humanforce, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is rostered at our Sydney site tomorrow, and in which roles?"; "Show the timesheets from last week that are not yet authorised."; "Which employees are clocked in right now at each location?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Humanforce data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run humanforce_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run humanforce_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run humanforce_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. humanforce_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: humanforce_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees with summary details (code, name, default location, department and role, active status). Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/employees.

activeOnly.description: Only active employees (true) or include terminated (false).

lastEdit.description: Only records changed since this date-time (ISO 8601).

tools.name: humanforce_get_employee
tools.title: Get an employee
tools.description: Get one employee with all details (personal, employment, roles, locations and departments). Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/employees/{guidKey}.

guidKey.description: GUID key of the record (from a list tool).

roleRevisionEffectiveDate.description: Role revision effective date (yyyy-mm-dd), if the role at a date matters.

tools.name: humanforce_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List locations with summary data (site names and codes). Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/locations.

tools.name: humanforce_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List all departments. Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/departments.

tools.name: humanforce_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List all roles (job roles used for rostering and pay). Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/roles.

tools.name: humanforce_list_shift_types
tools.title: List shift types
tools.description: List shift types, including leave types when isLeaveType is true. Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/shiftTypes.

isLeaveType.description: Only leave types (true) or only non-leave shift types (false).

tools.name: humanforce_list_pay_types
tools.title: List pay types
tools.description: List all pay types used in timesheets and payruns. Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/payTypes.

tools.name: humanforce_list_pay_companies
tools.title: List pay companies
tools.description: List the pay companies (legal payroll entities) in this tenant. Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/PayCompany.

tools.name: humanforce_list_roster_items
tools.title: List roster shifts
tools.description: List rostered shifts between two dates, with filters for employee, location, department and role. Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/rosterItems.

tools.name: humanforce_list_availability
tools.title: List availability
tools.description: List employee availability between two dates, optionally for one employee, location or department. Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/availability.

recurring.description: Only recurring availability (true) or only one-off (false).

tools.name: humanforce_list_public_holidays
tools.title: List public holidays
tools.description: List public holidays between two dates, optionally for one region. Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/publicHolidays.

tools.name: humanforce_get_clocking_status
tools.title: Get clocking status
tools.description: Get whether an employee is clocked in or out now, in their local time. Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/clocking/status.

timezoneOffset.description: Minutes offset from UTC for local time, for example 600 for Sydney and -240 for New York.

tools.name: humanforce_list_timesheets
tools.title: List timesheets
tools.description: List timesheets in a date range (or pay-date range), with filters for employee, location and approval. Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/timesheets.

usePayDate.description: Filter on the pay date (true) or the shift date (false).

tools.name: humanforce_list_leave_requests
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: List leave requests in a date range, optionally only approved ones or for one employee. Humanforce API: GET /api/1.0/leaveRequest.

approvedStatus.description: Only approved (true) or not approved (false) requests.

deleted.description: Only deleted (true) or not deleted (false) requests.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Humanforce
prompts.description: What you can do with Humanforce here, with example requests to try.
